title: for glm-4.1V update
bodyExcerpt:
This PR aims to upgrade the implementation of GLM-4.1V to be compatible with GLM-V implementations that use different base models but share the same VIT.
The current PR is incorrect, as discussed on Slack, because the transformers library architectures do not appear in the text config.

title: [Bugfix] Fix GLM-4.1-V video prompt update
bodyExcerpt:
## Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist
- [x] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".

- [ ] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results

## Purpose
- Fix the issue mentioned in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/19070#issuecomment-3047568781
- The video prompt update was implemented wrong by mistake, it should select only `video_token` as placeholder without timestamps tokens, otherwise the mm_placeholder index will be wrong with chunked-prefill.
